note: Alberta Parks campground in mature trees on the Little Red Deer River, 15 km west of Bowden on Highway 587, with a small store and playground; power sites are in Loop C. 28 of the 79 sites are posted under 23 ft (nine in Loop A, 15 of the power sites), so choose by the posted length. For 2026 the sani-dump and fill, showers and flush toilets were closed for wastewater repairs (vault toilets only; alternative sani-dump in Bowden). --Claude
